users.schema:
CREATE TABLE users (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    org_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    dept_id TEXT,
    position_id TEXT,
    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    full_name_lo TEXT NOT NULL,
    full_name_en TEXT NOT NULL,
    phone TEXT,
    avatar_url TEXT,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' CHECK(status IN ('ACTIVE', 'PENDING_ACTIVATION', 'SUSPENDED', 'LOCKED')),
    must_change_password INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    mfa_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    mfa_secret TEXT,
    failed_login_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    locked_until DATETIME,
    last_login_at DATETIME,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (org_id) REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (dept_id) REFERENCES departments(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (position_id) REFERENCES positions(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

user_invitations.schema:
CREATE TABLE user_invitations (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    org_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    dept_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    role_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    designated_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT,
    token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' CHECK(status IN ('PENDING', 'ACCEPTED', 'EXPIRED', 'REVOKED')),
    invited_by TEXT NOT NULL,
    expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
    accepted_at DATETIME,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (org_id) REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

document_number_sequences.schema:
CREATE TABLE document_number_sequences (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    dept_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    doc_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(doc_type IN ('INCOMING', 'OUTGOING', 'INTERNAL')),
    year INTEGER NOT NULL,
    current_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    UNIQUE(dept_id, doc_type, year),
    FOREIGN KEY (dept_id) REFERENCES departments(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

documents.schema:
CREATE TABLE documents (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    org_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    dept_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    reg_number TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    internal_ref TEXT,
    doc_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(doc_type IN ('INCOMING', 'OUTGOING', 'INTERNAL')),
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    summary TEXT,
    sender TEXT,
    recipient TEXT,
    doc_date DATE NOT NULL,
    received_date DATE,
    priority TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'NORMAL' CHECK(priority IN ('LOW', 'NORMAL', 'URGENT', 'VERY_URGENT')),
    confidentiality TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INTERNAL' CHECK(confidentiality IN ('PUBLIC', 'INTERNAL', 'CONFIDENTIAL', 'HIGHLY_CONFIDENTIAL')),
    workflow_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT' CHECK(workflow_status IN ('DRAFT', 'REGISTERED', 'ASSIGNED', 'IN_REVIEW', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'SIGNED', 'ARCHIVED', 'COMPLETED')),
    current_step INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    creator_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    responsible_user_id TEXT,
    qr_token TEXT UNIQUE,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (org_id) REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (dept_id) REFERENCES departments(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (creator_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

document_attachments.schema:
CREATE TABLE document_attachments (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    doc_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    file_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    file_type TEXT NOT NULL,
    file_size INTEGER NOT NULL,
    storage_key TEXT NOT NULL,
    content_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    uploader_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (doc_id) REFERENCES documents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (uploader_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

document_versions.schema:
CREATE TABLE document_versions (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    doc_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    version_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    summary TEXT,
    changed_by TEXT NOT NULL,
    change_summary TEXT NOT NULL,
    file_attachment_id TEXT,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (doc_id) REFERENCES documents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (changed_by) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (file_attachment_id) REFERENCES document_attachments(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

document_workflow_steps.schema:
CREATE TABLE document_workflow_steps (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    doc_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    step_number INTEGER NOT NULL,
    step_name_lo TEXT NOT NULL,
    step_name_en TEXT NOT NULL,
    assignee_user_id TEXT,
    assignee_role TEXT NOT NULL,
    action TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING' CHECK(action IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'RETURNED_FOR_REVISION', 'ASSIGNED', 'SUBMITTED', 'SIGNED')),
    comments TEXT,
    acted_at DATETIME,
    deadline_at DATETIME,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (doc_id) REFERENCES documents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (assignee_user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

document_signatures.schema:
CREATE TABLE document_signatures (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    doc_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    signer_user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    signer_name_lo TEXT NOT NULL,
    signer_name_en TEXT NOT NULL,
    signer_title TEXT NOT NULL,
    signature_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(signature_type IN ('DRAWN', 'UPLOADED_STAMP', 'DIGITAL_SEAL')),
    signature_data TEXT NOT NULL,
    document_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
    verification_token TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    signed_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    ip_address TEXT,
    is_valid INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    FOREIGN KEY (doc_id) REFERENCES documents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (signer_user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

notifications.schema:
CREATE TABLE notifications (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    title_lo TEXT NOT NULL,
    title_en TEXT NOT NULL,
    message_lo TEXT NOT NULL,
    message_en TEXT NOT NULL,
    type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'INFO' CHECK(type IN ('INFO', 'APPROVAL_REQUEST', 'DOCUMENT_APPROVED', 'DOCUMENT_REJECTED', 'REVISION_REQUESTED', 'DEADLINE_ALERT', 'SIGNATURE_COMPLETED')),
    entity_type TEXT DEFAULT 'DOCUMENT',
    entity_id TEXT,
    is_read INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
